name: vbs-songs
title: VBS Songs
subtitle: English songs for children and group worship

cover.alt: Illustrated VBS Songs cover with children singing around an open Bible

intro.summary: A growing collection of public-domain English hymns and traditional spirituals suitable for Vacation Bible School, Sunday school, and group singing.
intro.description: Sing familiar songs about faith, creation, joy, courage, and the life of Jesus. This edition intentionally includes only older public-domain texts and traditional songs with no known modern lyric additions.

credits.compiledBy: Public-domain children’s hymn and spiritual sources
credits.rights: Included texts are public-domain hymns or traditional spirituals. Modern arrangements, recordings, and later lyric additions may have separate rights.

changelog.note: Expanded to 36 songs with child-friendly mission songs and adult congregational hymns for mixed-age VBS worship.
First edition with eighteen public-domain English songs for children and group worship.
